title: Portugal Golden Visa Guide — Test Build

pages.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Portugal's residency by investment programme — eligibility, investment routes, and the application process explained.

blocks.heading: A Gateway to Europe
blocks.leadPara: Portugal's Golden Visa remains one of the most flexible residency-by-investment routes in Europe, requiring minimal physical presence while offering a clear path to permanent residency and citizenship.
body: Since its introduction, the programme has attracted thousands of investors seeking a legally established alternative for themselves and their families, combining lifestyle appeal with long-term optionality.

Recent reforms have shifted the programme away from direct real estate acquisition toward investment funds and other qualifying routes, while preserving the core benefits that made it attractive in the first place.

blocks.heading: From Application to Residency
blocks.subtitle: A streamlined five-step process, from initial eligibility review to your first residency card.

steps.title: Eligibility Review
steps.desc: We assess your profile and confirm the best-fit investment route for your goals.

steps.title: Investment Selection
steps.desc: Choose from qualifying investment funds with guidance from our advisory team.

steps.title: Documentation
steps.desc: We prepare and notarize the full application package on your behalf.

steps.title: Submission & Biometrics
steps.desc: Application is submitted and biometric data collected at a regional office.

steps.title: Residency Card Issued
steps.desc: Your first residency card is issued, valid for two years and renewable.

blocks.ctaBody: Speak with one of our licensed advisors to explore whether the Portugal Golden Visa is the right fit for your goals.
